## Summary
[What’s the new thing you’re proposing? Keep it concise and clear. It should solve a problem or improve the improve the project (either UX, developer experience, etc)]

## Problem Statement / Use Case
[What pain point does this solve? Who is asking for it, and why? If there’s a specific workflow that’s currently painful, describe it.]

## Proposed Solution
[High‑level description of what the feature could look like. This doesn’t need to be a full spec—just enough to start a conversation. If you have a rough design, UX mockup, or API sketch, mention it.]

## Alternatives Considered (Optional)
[Have you thought about other ways to solve the same problem? Why are they worse or better?]

## Location / Area
[Which part of the codebase or system would this touch? e.g., "Auth service", "Frontend dashboard", "Public API".]

## Things to note
[Any dependencies, third‑party integrations, or existing pieces that this feature would interact with. Also mention if this should be a breaking change or if it can be rolled out incrementally.]
